finalText:
All 625 tests pass now.

**Root cause:** in `src/pricing.js`, `orderTotal` was computing tax on the pre-discount `cents` instead of the post-discount amount — so tax got charged on the original price, not what the customer actually pays. Fixed by taxing `discounted` instead of `cents`; the other 622 cases passed already because most rows had a zero discount or zero tax, which masked the bug.
